root_cause.text: The `check_rkey` function in `drivers/infiniband/sw/rxe/rxe_resp.c` fails to validate that the payload length of an `ATOMIC_WRITE` request is exactly 8 bytes, allowing zero-length requests to bypass validation and trigger an out-of-bounds read in `atomic_write_reply`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a strict length check `resid != sizeof(u64) || pktlen != sizeof(u64) || bth_pad(pkt)` for `RXE_ATOMIC_WRITE_MASK` in `check_rkey()`, and the commit message explains that `check_rkey()` previously accepted zero-length `ATOMIC_WRITE` requests, leading to an out-of-bounds read of 8 bytes in `atomic_write_reply()`.
